package.description: AI-powered metes and bounds and deed plotting software for land surveyors, CAD technicians, title abstractors, and GIS departments.

en-US.author: Deed Reader Pro, LLC
en-US.description: AI-powered metes and bounds and deed plotting software for land surveyors, CAD technicians, title abstractors, and GIS departments.
en-US.longDescription: Deed Reader Pro is metes and bounds plotting software that uses AI to transcribe deeds in PDF, image, and Word format, extract the legal descriptions, and parse bearing and distance calls into an editable Call Table. Tracts can be edited with real-time plot updates and plotted directly in AutoCAD, Civil 3D, and IntelliCAD, with DXF and ArcGIS traverse file export. Closure error and closure reports, merged plots, adjoiners, PLSS references, and a GLO map tool built on BLM GIS data are included.
en-US.name: Deed Reader Pro

zh-CN.description: 面向土地测量师、CAD 技术人员、产权摘要师和 GIS 部门的 AI 界址点与地契绘图软件。
zh-CN.longDescription: Deed Reader Pro 是一款界址点（metes and bounds）与地契绘图软件，使用 AI 将 PDF、图片和 Word 格式的地契转写为文本并提取法定描述，再把方位角与距离记录解析为可编辑的 Call Table。用户可在实时绘图更新中编辑地块，并直接输出到 AutoCAD、Civil 3D 与 IntelliCAD，同时支持 DXF 和 ArcGIS 导线文件导出。软件还提供闭合差与闭合报告、合并绘图、相邻地块、PLSS 引用以及基于 BLM GIS 数据的 GLO 地图工具。
